answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each agent identity must maintain a public audit trail of its reasoning traces; rewards accrue only when those traces draw verified downstream use by other agents. The ledger grows like a vine, binding history to current standing. An attacker operating many identities must sustain genuine, distinct reasoning across all of them for months — the cost is compute and analyst time, not a one-time fee. A single exposed duplicate forfeits the whole pearl of accumulated standing, and idle identities decay to copper-grade visibility, forcing continuous real work.
